title: SidecarProgressV1Result
description: A point-in-time view of one request's on-device progress. `trace` carries the same append-only event log a result may embed, so a client that applies steps by `sequence` (last one wins) renders a polled log and a complete log identically.

state.description: Where the named request is in its lifecycle. Known values are running, finished, and unknown. Receivers treat unrecognized values as running.

trace.description: The sidecar's step log for the named request so far. Metadata only — never message content. Absent when the request is unknown or recorded no steps.
